# `aitbc agent config-validate`

Validate the configuration of a named agent against the schema.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent config-validate [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | yes | Agent name. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent config-validate --name <name>
```
